basic_info.description: One-of-a-kind view penthouse condominium in exclusive Nob Hill! This uniquely fabulous home features stunning outlooks through oversized windows of the downtown skyline, iconic Coit Tower, the Bay Bridge, the waters of the Bay, and city views to the south, east and west. Perched atop a boutique building, this sprawling residence offers 4 bedrooms and 3 baths, rich detail, and incredible entertaining and gathering spaces with a dining room with coffered ceiling, and formal living room with a gas fireplace. On the main level is an eat-in kitchen, equipped with deluxe appliances, a center island with cooktop and informal dining banquette, and multiple sinks. Adjacent to the kitchen is a guest bedroom or study, and down the hall is a full bathroom with shower and stacked washer/dryer. Upstairs are 3 generous bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, including a spacious primary suite with views of the Bay Bridge, Coit Tower, and the downtown skyline. Up one flight of stairs is a shared roofdeck, offering 360 views across the city. The residence is unique in its beautiful moldings and columns and rich detail. Includes 1-car parking in the building garage, with room for storage. Wonderful Nob Hill location, close to shops and dining in North Beach and Chinatown, with an easy commute downtown.
